title: Crashes in Vulkan renderer
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible at head - fa6cad230f638d65a5a897008c5fc512edc237ad
The regression must have been introduced in the last week or so

### System information

Windows 10, Godot built at fa6cad230f638d65a5a897008c5fc512edc237ad, RX 6800XT, driver 26.2.2

### Issue description

I see frequent crashes at HEAD (currently at fa6cad230f638d65a5a897008c5fc512edc237ad), in a complex project about every three - four minutes.

I suspect it's the re-spirv version bump https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/ed97644b607d7b20877acdf3a0846c46775c8480

I think it's mangling branches, but do not understand it enough.

Bisecting points to this change, but I am not super sure given the crash happens randomly. What I'm sure of is that it has been introduced in the past couple of days.



### Steps to reproduce

Open a complex project
